Definition: Mikajah, the name of an Israelite and an Israelitess
BiblicalUsage: Michaiah = "who is like God"; n pr m; 1) one of the princes of Jehoshaphat whom he sent to teach the law of Jehovah in the cities of Judah; 2) daughter of Uriel of Gibeah, wife of king Rehoboam of Judah, and mother of king Abijah of Judah
